sloka: न त्वं स्त्रीसन्निधौ वीर वचनं वक्तुमर्हसि ।मम युद्धं प्रयच्छाद्य ततो ज्ञास्यामि ते बलम् ॥४-११-३२॥।।
transliteration: na tvaṁ strīsannidhau vīra vacanaṁ vaktumarhasi ।mama yuddhaṁ prayacchādya tato jñāsyāmi te balam ॥4-11-32॥।।

translations.english: 'O hero speaking such words in the presence of women is not proper. Come to me for a combat and I will let you know your strength.
